libheif-js 1.23.5
https://github.com/catdad-experiments/libheif-js
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/libheif-js@1.23.5/libheif-wasm/libheif.js
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/libheif-js@1.23.5/libheif-wasm/libheif.wasm

What this is
An Emscripten build of libheif (with libde265) that decodes HEIC/HEIF photos in the browser.
Caviot Studio loads these two files only after a HEIC photo fails the browser's own decoder.
The photo never leaves the device.

Licence
libheif, libde265, and the libheif-js wrapper are LGPL-3.0. The full text is LICENSE in this folder.
Copyright (c) struktur AG, Dirk Farin, and the libheif and libde265 contributors.
libheif-js wrapper by Kiril Vatev and contributors.

How to replace the library (LGPL section 4)
These files are loaded separately, not mixed into Caviot's own scripts:
  vendor/libheif/libheif.js
  vendor/libheif/libheif.wasm
Replace both with your own build of the same interface and the studio will use them.
heic.js expects:
  a global factory libheif(options) when libheif.js is loaded in a page
  options.wasmBinary, the wasm bytes fetched first (this build cannot read the wasm file synchronously on the page)
  options.locateFile(name) to find libheif.wasm
  options.onRuntimeInitialized
  new module.HeifDecoder(); decoder.decode(Uint8Array) -> images
  image.get_width(), image.get_height(), image.display({data, width, height}, callback), image.free()
